summary: Iteration 11: Verified SEED versioning fix (SEED_VERSION=2, seed_data.json). Simulated empty-DB by dropping meta/settings/categories/menu_items/gallery collections then restarted backend — reseed executed automatically with 'Seeded content v2' logged. All content restored: settings (phone 0 (212) 809 27 62, address Karadeniz Mahallesi..., email destek@cafedelnord.com.tr, hours_weekday 10:00-22:00, hours_weekend 10:00-23:00, instagram https://www.instagram.com/cafedelnord, whatsapp 905342878402, reservation_enabled=false), 4 categories, 33 menu items (all with gastronomic descriptions ~120 chars and full name_de/ru/ar translations, 0 missing), 16 gallery photos. Idempotency verified: 2nd restart did NOT re-seed (log count of 'Seeded content v2' stayed at 2 from initial drops; meta.version=2 persisted; items still 33). Mobile 390x844 /iletisim: 'Admin panelinden eklenebilir' placeholder NOT present; Telefon/Adres/E-posta/Çalışma Saatleri all populated with real data; footer includes address/hours/email. Home page has Instagram (cafedelnord) and WhatsApp (905342878402) links. Desktop 1920 regression: /menu shows 33 cards, /galeri shows 16 imgs, DE language switch works (Kumpir → 'Kumpir (Gefüllte Ofenkartoffel)' with full German description), no webpack/error-boundary overlays, /admin loads Yönetim Paneli with Google login button.
critical_code_review_comments: seed() unconditionally deletes categories/menu_items/gallery collections (delete_many({}) outside the data.get() guards) — if seed_data.json is malformed or missing a section, that section would be wiped. Currently OK because data is validated at file load, but consider guarding each delete_many with data.get() check to avoid data loss risk on partial seed files.

seed_data_creation: Dropped meta/settings/categories/menu_items/gallery collections to simulate empty deploy DB; users/user_sessions preserved. Reseed populated everything correctly via SEED_VERSION=2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deploy fix verified via empty-DB simulation. SEED_VERSION=2 gate in /app/backend/server.py:530 with db.meta versioning. seed_data.json holds full production content (4 cats/33 items with 4 lang translations + 116-127 char descriptions, 16 gallery, complete settings). Idempotent — safe to redeploy. If future content updates required, increment SEED_VERSION and regenerate seed_data.json export. Reservation endpoint is 403 by design (reservation_enabled=false in seed).
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Content updates were written directly to dev MongoDB (test_database), but the deploy environment provisions a fresh/isolated DB whose seed() only ran once (idempotent by document existence check) — leaving prod DB with stale/empty seed while dev continued to be updated. Mobile users on cafedelnord.com.tr saw 'Admin panelinden eklenebilir' fallbacks because the settings collection lacked phone/address/email/hours in prod. FIX: (1) Exported dev's full state to /app/backend/seed_data.json. (2) Introduced SEED_VERSION=2 constant tracked in db.meta {id:'seed'}; on startup if meta.version<SEED_VERSION, drop settings/categories/menu_items/gallery and re-insert from JSON, then set meta.version=SEED_VERSION. (3) users/user_sessions untouched. Verified reproduction: drop collections → restart → all data restored with correct log 'Seeded content v2'; 2nd restart is a no-op. Mobile /iletisim now shows real data on both dev and (once deployed) prod.
